model.route: A* Manhattan route planned once from known exact start on the static four-neighbor grid.
model.controller: Exact position for privileged oracle; otherwise estimated position and current waypoint only. Clamped displacement at v*dt; accept one waypoint within 0.10 m after estimator update.
model.sensors: Odometry = actual clipped displacement + b*dt + Gaussian perturbation. Absolute fix = current truth + Gaussian perturbation. Fixes begin at step10, never step0.
model.random: 32-bit LCG (1664525,1013904223), uniform=(state+0.5)/2^32. Four uniforms per interval, two Box–Muller pairs for odometry and absolute errors. All methods/schedules consume every draw, including missing fixes.
model.estimators: Dead reckoning integrates odometry and ignores fixes. Linear Kalman predicts two independent position coordinates, then corrects only on a fresh fix. Exact reference gets truth and ignores sensors.
model.covariance: Identity F/B/H; Pminus=P+Q, K=Pminus/(Pminus+R), Pplus=(1-K)^2*Pminus+K^2*R (Joseph). No bias state: fixed nonzero bias violates zero-mean assumptions; covariance is not calibrated true error.
eventOrder: Move true point and evaluate swept contact
Generate displacement and optional absolute reading
Accept waypoint from estimate unless contact
model.stopping: Contact takes priority. At controller completion, actual goal distance <=0.25m is arrived, otherwise false-arrival. Stop at400 intervals if still following; terminal runs never process future restoration.
model.errorMetric: Euclidean estimated-minus-true position. RMS includes initialization and all snapshots through that run’s own terminal step. Seed-group mean is an unweighted average of per-run RMS values, not a fixed-duration benchmark.
model.fidelity: Single point robot, exact known initial pose/map, no heading/dynamics, body radius, avoidance, replanning, real GNSS/IMU/SLAM or shared estimates.
